scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: The Connection Lab’s guide is almost ready. Its artwork is clean, but a former volunteer still has editing access and one photo lacks agreement for public use. Neel wants to publish because the privacy section passed yesterday; Tara checks the other conditions.
scenes.speech: The Connection Lab’s guide is almost ready. Its artwork is clean, but a former volunteer still has editing access and one photo lacks agreement for public use. Neel wants to publish because the privacy section passed yesterday; Tara checks the other conditions.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: A release decision combines several kinds of evidence. Removing a location clue does not end an old session, and a correct permission does not supply photo consent. The team lists each remaining issue, its owner and the observation that would show a repair worked.
scenes.speech: A release decision combines several kinds of evidence. Removing a location clue does not end an old session, and a correct permission does not supply photo consent. The team lists each remaining issue, its owner and the observation that would show a repair worked.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The teacher checks the final public preview, current role list and tested approved backup. An unapproved photo stays out. When a new editor or audience is proposed, the team reviews again instead of treating yesterday’s approval as permanent proof for a different plan.
scenes.speech: The teacher checks the final public preview, current role list and tested approved backup. An unapproved photo stays out. When a new editor or audience is proposed, the team reviews again instead of treating yesterday’s approval as permanent proof for a different plan.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: Former-volunteer editing access and missing photo consent remain unresolved. The proposed audience is now public. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: Former-volunteer editing access and missing photo consent remain unresolved. The proposed audience is now public. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.dialogue: Is yesterday’s privacy pass enough to publish today?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: Complete and verify the remaining repairs with the teacher before release. A previous check of one issue does not establish readiness for a changed whole plan.
scenes.speech: Complete and verify the remaining repairs with the teacher before release. A previous check of one issue does not establish readiness for a changed whole plan.
scenes.dialogue: Connect each repair with an observable check.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate a connected risk review, then evidence of each repair, then changed release conditions. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
scenes.speech: Investigate a connected risk review, then evidence of each repair, then changed release conditions. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
scenes.dialogue: Name a risk, its repair and the evidence that would show the repair worked.
